items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Because Duke heard you and he'd like to have you. He asked for you to come down and rehearse, you know.

ctx.x: So I didn't go, and you know, I always thought of Sonny, because they left there the next day and went to the theater in -- Shea's in Toronto, and he called me up, you know. "Hey, man, what happened?" You know, so I told him I thought I'd better not do it. I said I'd better lay dead around here a little longer, you know. I'm pretty well set here, you know. So he said, "Okay. Maybe next time. Because Duke heard you and he'd like to have you. He asked for you to come down and rehearse, you know."
Funny, isn't it? You don't know what might have happened.
